summary.title: A technical due diligence checklist - CircleCI
summary.one_liner: Learn what auditors ask about culture, technical debt and growth readiness during tech due diligence, and which documents to prepare beforehand.
keywords: how to prepare for due diligence
takeaways: Expect auditor interviews covering company culture, technical debt, and growth readiness.
Prepare documentation such as org charts, product and technology roadmaps, and architecture diagrams.
Optimize the data request document so it gives the most complete picture of the product.
Prepare both logistically and mentally for the audit process.
summary.summary: This CircleCI resource is a guide to technical due diligence for M&A or fundraising audits. It outlines the questions auditors typically raise in interviews about company culture, technical debt, and growth readiness. It also lists documentation to prepare, such as org charts, roadmaps, and architecture diagrams, and explains how to answer a data request document thoroughly. The page text is brief and summary-level, so it gives an overview rather than detailed step-by-step procedures.
